verdict.rationale: Offline reading, searching and writing with sync on reconnect is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents offline mode, local caching on the client, or a queued-sync mechanism. Storing emails in a Durable Object and an R2 bucket is server-side storage for speed, not offline client capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect
